id: gen_plan_experiment_1_idx1
type: experiment
domain_practice: |-
  How a methods-reframing Benford/conformity paper in clustered panel data is actually built, from the strategist's OpenAlex/Crossref scan for this round plus the standard estimator literature I can state exactly. Live web verification was NOT possible in this planning step (no web tool on a text pod), so every item below is either from that scan or from a textbook convention whose formula I reproduce verbatim; the executor must spend <=20 min confirming the two exact citations marked [VERIFY] before they appear in the report, and must not cite anything it cannot confirm.

  1. BASELINES AND COMPARISONS every such paper carries. (i) The conventional exact-Benford battery at nominal n - first-digit MAD with Nigrini's bands NAMED but never used as the verdict (Nigrini 2012); chi-square with df and the explicit independence caveat; Kuiper V on mantissas with Stephens' (1970) critical values 1.747/sqrt(n) at 5%; Bonferroni-Wilson simultaneous per-digit intervals (Lesperance, Reed et al. 2016, PLoS ONE [VERIFY: volume/pages]) computed at BOTH the naive n and the corrected n_eff. (ii) The same battery under a matched, dependence-respecting null - this is the comparison a reviewer names FIRST if missing, and the run's own reviewer MAJOR is precisely its absence. (iii) Ablations (microstates <= 1e6, SIDS, top-20) and source invariance (WDI vs WPP). (iv) A placebo/power suite proving the instruments can reject at all - without it no pass is interpretable.
  2. CASES AND DATA. The standard object is the complete population-of-countries ensemble from UN WPP via OWID plus World Bank WDI SP.POP.TOTL as an independent-ish cross-check; Sandron (2002, Population 57:755-762) is the founding descriptive study on exactly this ensemble. Population panels are NOT saturated (nothing cluster-aware has been published on them - the scan found no cluster-aware or design-effect-corrected Benford test on panel data), but they ARE a census: n_countries = 236 is a hard ceiling, which drives the whole power argument. Deprecated/unrepresentative choices to avoid: aggregates (World, continents, income groups, EU/OECD) must stay excluded by the auditable rule already in the panel; projections (2024-2025) must stay out of the primary window; 'persons vs thousands' is the classic unit error, caught by the 2023 sum check.
  3. CONTROLS AND WHAT IS HELD CONSTANT. Held fixed across every comparison: the row set (the same 17,464/8,732 rows), the digit-derivation path (string-derived d1, not log10-rounded), the mantissa convention (fractional part of log10, [0,1)), the fold tags, and the statistic definitions. The confound this design is most likely to be caught on is the dependence correction itself: a frequency-type design effect applied to a circular-mean statistic (the exact flip the reviewer found), and a null that fails to reproduce the observed within-country concentration kappa_i so that it is silently too wide. Secondary confounds: within-country serial correlation (all five statistics are marginal and therefore insensitive to time order - the plan states this and verifies it), and multiplicity across 5 statistics x 2 folds x 4 disjoint folds (Holm within each family).
  4. HOW MUCH IS ENOUGH. Placebo replicates B >= 4,000 where a p-value is reported near 0.05 (Monte-Carlo se = sqrt(p(1-p)/B) = 0.0022) and B = 10,000 for the operative instrument; 500 synthetic panels for level calibration (FPR se 0.0097); 200 for each powered alternative; 10,000 country-bootstrap resamples for the |c1| interval. Below ~1,000 replicates nobody in this literature quotes a p near 0.05. Every point estimate is reported WITH an interval: point + 95% Rayleigh interval + country-bootstrap interval + the analytic detection threshold + the placebo p. A reviewer of a methods-reframing paper also expects a NAMED-NOVELTY paragraph stating the delta over the nearest published treatment (nearest neighbours from the scan: 'Benford's law as an indicator of survey reliability', J. Economic Surveys 2019; Bustillos & Leiva 2026, Chilean J. Statistics 17, matched-null reframe for power laws; the 2026 arXiv paper arguing the ICC, not the design effect, governs survey-aware CV; Kish 1965 design effect; McGraw & Wong 1996 ICC conventions; Mardia & Jupp 2000 Rayleigh test) - the plan requires that paragraph as an output row.
  5. MEASURES AND REPORTING CONVENTIONS. MAD (mean |p_d - b_d| over 9 digits, in probability units, reported to 5 dp with Nigrini's band named); chi-square X^2 with df = 8 and BOTH the naive p and the DE-scaled p; sup-distance M = sup_m |F_emp(m) - m| on mantissas (KS-to-uniform); Kuiper V with Stephens' 5% critical; |c1| with phase in degrees, reported as amplitude + Rayleigh CI + analytic threshold; and for every statistic a placebo p, an observed/median-null ratio, and an interval. The field also expects the raw data, the digit vectors, the full list of tested series (each fold and subset) and per-case audit rows deposited beside the tests (the style exemplars in this area release exactly that: raw observations, per-digit summaries, list of tested series, case-level audit) - the plan's deliverable list mirrors it.
practice_alignment: |-
  POINT BY POINT against domain_practice.

  (1) Baselines. MEETS: the conventional battery (MAD, chi-square, sup-M, Kuiper V, |c1|) is recomputed at nominal n with Nigrini bands named and never used as a verdict, chi-square with df and the independence caveat, Kuiper with Stephens' critical values, Bonferroni-Wilson intervals at naive n and at n_eff; ablation and source-invariance rows retained as robustness (not as the refuted lead claim). MEETS: a matched dependence-respecting null is the centre of the artifact, not an add-on. MEETS: a power/placebo suite is a pre-registered deliverable (uniform-digit law and narrow lognormal sigma=0.1 must be rejected at p<0.0005; an i.i.d. uniform-mantissa panel must be flagged over-regular). No departure.

  (2) Data. MEETS: uses the field's standard ensemble (UN WPP via OWID + WDI cross-check), aggregates excluded by the panel's auditable rule, projections excluded, 2023 sum check against 8,090,655,899 persons. DEPARTURE: only one fold-pair plus a 4-way entity-disjoint split is run, not many resamples; justified because the panel is a census (n_countries = 236 is exhaustive, so resampling adds nothing beyond the bootstrap CI which IS run) - cost: no external replication, stated as a limit, not hidden.

  (3) Controls. MEETS: row set, digit path, mantissa convention, fold tags and statistic definitions are held fixed and asserted by checks; Holm applied within the 5-statistic family and within the 4-fold family. MEETS-BY-DESIGN the main confound: the frequency-type-vs-circular-mean misapplication is not just corrected but made the explicable object of the two-row table, and the second confound (a null too wide because it ignores observed kappa) is caught by an explicit kappa-calibration diagnostic between the rotation null and the parametric placebo. No departure.

  (4) How much is enough. MEETS: B = 10,000 operative / 4,000 reporting, 500-panel FPR calibration, 200-panel powered alternatives, 10,000 bootstrap resamples, Holm within families, point-with-interval for every estimate, named-novelty paragraph required as an output row. MEETS the underpowered-panel rule honestly: rather than adding candidate metrics to drown the power problem, the plan ADDS a pre-registered discrimination-power bound (the |c1| amplitude that 236 countries CAN resolve, and the n_countries that would be needed) and reports the observed amplitude against it. DEPARTURE: the entity-disjoint 4-fold check cannot detect an effect of the observed size (each fold has n_c = 59; MDA at 80% power ~0.22-0.39 vs observed 0.075). Justified as a genuine arithmetic limit of a census, and mitigated by reframing the disjoint folds as an ESTIMATE-STABILITY test (per-fold |c1| with Rayleigh CIs + a homogeneity test) rather than a detection test, which is what they can actually support. Cost: the reviewer's 'entity-disjoint fold check' is delivered in a weaker but truthful form, and the plan says so in the output instead of claiming four passes.

  (5) Measures and reporting. MEETS: the exact measure definitions, units, decimals, Nigrini bands named-only, df-carrying chi-square with both p-values, Stephens criticals, phase in degrees, observed/median-null ratios, and the deposited-data convention (raw rows, digit vectors, tested-series list, per-case audit with kappa_i and influence). MEETS the domain_vocabulary rule: the plan uses only field-standard names - intraclass correlation, one-way ANOVA estimator ICC(1), design effect, effective sample size, Rayleigh test, Kuiper statistic, sup-distance, mean absolute deviation, harmonic/Fourier coefficient, randomization test - and introduces exactly ONE new object with an explicit definition ('country-rotation randomization null', defined once at first use, same words everywhere after). No 'level-X' or other run-bookkeeping code appears in body text; those stay as table row labels only.

  (6) Novelty positioning. MEETS: the named-novelty paragraph against the seven nearest published treatments is a required output row, and it states the delta precisely: prior cluster-aware work in survey statistics corrects FREQUENCY summaries by a design effect; the delta here is that the Benford panel case has a circular-mean statistic whose df is the cluster count, and that the rotation null removes the need for any design-effect estimate at all while remaining exact.

  RESIDUAL COST AFTER FIXING WHAT CAN BE FIXED: the verdict remains a statement about one census, so its external validity rests on the mechanism (multiplicative growth -> near-Benford) not on replication; and the discrimination bound means the paper cannot positively confirm the fitted mixture over exact Benford, only that the two are within the ensemble's resolution - the plan requires that to be stated as the sharpened positive rather than as a failure.
builds_on: |-
  REUSED FROM THE DECLARED DEPENDENCY art_ym9ZVhHxA-vn (staged into the executor's workspace; the only artifact whose files the executor receives):
  1. full_data_out.json (43 MiB, 18,012 examples) - THE primary input. One example per entity-year with FLAT metadata_* fields entity, iso_code, entity_class, year, population, value_str, source_variant, is_projection, in_primary_analysis, in_primary_analysis_sovereign_only, pop_le_1m, is_sids, is_top20, rank_in_year, mantissa, d1, d2, d1_reciprocal, n_sig_figs, trailing_zeros, entity_year_rank_source, fold ('even' = screen half, 'odd' = reserved). No derived statistics are stored (no digit table, MAD, chi-square, Kuiper statistic, fit or bootstrap), so every number this artifact reports is computed fresh by this artifact's own code. Filter metadata_in_primary_analysis == true -> 236 entities x 74 years (1950-2023) = 17,464 rows, split 8,732 even / 8,732 odd.
  2. data.py - reused as the ACQUISITION RECIPE for the fallback path only (it contains the OWID 'population-with-un-projections' estimates/projection column logic and the aggregate-exclusion rule). It is also the integrity oracle: it reproduces full_data_out.json byte-for-byte at md5 a338376ff319aa913078df4669fde237.
  3. reproducibility.md - the source provenance and the acceptance checks (notably the 2023 sum over in_primary_analysis entities = 8,090,655,899 persons, which catches the persons-vs-thousands error).

  REUSED AS FINDINGS, NOT FILES. art_04FdxASEUd1B and art_4wZNFo7Nh_VZ are NOT dependencies, are not staged, and their workspaces may already be purged - so their numbers are used here only as TEXT TARGETS for reconciliation, never read from disk: rho 0.9575 / DE 35.47 / n_eff 246; ICC 0.2206 / DE 8.94 / n_eff 976.7; |c1| 0.0749 (even) and 0.0752 (odd); 2-sigma 0.0901 and 0.0453; MAD 0.00919/0.00935; sup-M 0.03065; chi-square 83.2/91.69; Kuiper V 0.0561/0.04205; entity |c1| 0.0736; mixture budget 0.035767 and 0.035474; provenance vectors (65,33,35,23,17,17,21,10,15)/236 with MAD 0.01729, chi-square 9.45, |c1| 0.0736 and MAD 0.02029, chi-square 10.18, |c1| 0.1043; within-country mantissa sd 0.028 decades; placebo ps 0.365-0.927; 88.7% two-null LR overlap; ablation pass count 0/3.

  NEGATIVE FINDINGS REUSED SO THEY ARE NOT RE-COVERED: (a) the narrow-component selectivity / 'digits as spectroscopy' lead is REFUTED (ablation 0/3 predicted sign patterns; graded width-amplitude Spearman rho 0.10, p 0.87) - this plan therefore does NOT rerun the three ablations as a lead test, only recomputes their pass count as one robustness row under the corrected null; (b) the post-ablation refit asymmetry (7/9, 8/9, 9/9 signs) is already explained by deletion absorbing part of the effect - not retested; (c) the entity-disjoint check's prior 2-of-4 pass is treated as underpowered by construction (see the power bound below), so it is re-decided rather than re-run as a detection test.

  NOT AVAILABLE, REBUILT: nothing material. Only the six prior figures and the prior PRE_REGISTRATION.md are unavailable; the pre-registration is rewritten fresh (it must be, since this round's estimator declaration differs).
title: Re-testing Benford fit with the right dependence null
summary: >-
  One pre-registered, end-to-end re-derivation of How-closely-does-Benford-fit from the verified 236-country x 74-year UN-WPP
  panel (dependency art_ym9ZVhHxA-vn, full_data_out.json), which settles the ICC-estimator contradiction that gated iteration
  1. The plan does five things: (1) declares the standard one-way ANOVA ICC(1) as the estimator for frequency-type digit statistics
  and shows algebraically that the screen's rho = MSB/(MSB+MSW) overstates it by ((k-1)x + x^2)/((1+x)(1+(k-1)x)), so the
  screen always deflates n_eff; (2) shows by hand that BOTH recorded |c1| thresholds (screen 0.0901 at n_eff 246, evaluation
  0.0453 at n_eff 976) are the SAME formula 2*sigma with sigma = sqrt(0.5*sum w_i^2 kappa_i^2) at different n - so the contradiction
  is a choice-of-n problem, not two different theories; (3) derives the correct analytic cluster null for the circular-mean
  statistic c1 = sum_i w_i zbar_i as Rayleigh with sigma_R = sqrt(0.5*sum w_i^2 kappa_i^2), whose degrees of freedom are n_countries
  = 236 and NOT n_eff, with closed-form 2-sigma, 5% and 80%-power MDA thresholds; (4) introduces the country-rotation randomization
  test m*_it = (m_it + phi_i) mod 1 as the exact, assumption-light cluster null that holds every within-country trajectory
  fixed and subsumes both instruments, validated against Rayleigh; and (5) reports a pre-registered discrimination-power bound
  in place of the 88.7%-overlap claim. Also delivers the two demanded hygiene fixes: a definitional identification lattice
  that pins the disputed entity-level provenance numbers (0.01729/9.45/0.0736 vs 0.02029/10.18/0.1043) to explicit definitions,
  and harmonic-value canonicalization of the mixture budget (0.035767 vs 0.035474). CPU-only numpy/scipy, ~40 min compute,
  $0 OpenRouter spend.
runpod_compute_profile: cpu_basic
implementation_pseudocode: |-
  PROJECT LAYOUT (all paths relative to the artifact workspace)
    analysis/panel_io.py        load + integrity gate + fold/split construction
    analysis/stats.py           the five statistics + threshold formulas + placebo MC
    analysis/reconcile.py       two-row estimator table, algebra identity, kappa calibration
    analysis/synthetic.py       derivation validation + FPR/power calibration
    analysis/provenance.py      entity-level definitional identification lattice
    analysis/canonical.py       harmonic-value canonicalization
    analysis/verify.py          INDEPENDENT second code path re-derivation (plain numpy, no shared helpers)
    analysis/main.py            orchestrator -> results/*.json
    results/PRE_REGISTRATION_RECONCILIATION.md  (written and hashed BEFORE main.py touches the panel)
    results/  full_method_out.json, mini_method_out.json, preview_method_out.json,
              reconciliation.json, verdict.json, figures/ (via aii-data-fig-gen)
    README.md, .aii/manifest.yaml

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- STAGE 0: PRE-REGISTER (must precede any statistic)
  write PRE_REGISTRATION_RECONCILIATION.md containing, verbatim:
    (a) DECLARED ESTIMATOR. One-way ANOVA estimator, Searle/McGraw-Wong convention [VERIFY via McGraw & Wong 1996]:
          x = MSW/MSB ; ICC1 = (MSB - MSW)/(MSB + (k-1)*MSW) = (1-x)/(1+(k-1)x) ; k = 37
          DE = 1 + (k-1)*ICC1 ; n_eff = n/DE ; n = 8732 per fold
        Applied ONLY to frequency-type statistics: MAD (first digit), chi-square (first digit), sup-distance M (mantissa), Kuiper V (mantissa).
        Declared variate for the digit-frequency family: the per-row digit INDICATOR vector 1{d1 = d}, d = 1..9 (binary, variance p(1-p) <= 0.25 -> Kish's homogeneity caveat is mild); the ICC1 is also computed on the continuous mantissa for the descriptive row, with both reported and the declared one named.
    (b) CLASS TABLE. {MAD, chi-square, M, Kuiper V} -> n_eff. {|c1|} -> n_countries = 236 (weighted df, never n_eff). Written out as a table with a column that literally says which class each n governs.
    (c) |c1| NULL. c1 = sum_i w_i zbar_i, zbar_i = (1/k_i) sum_t exp(2*pi*i*m_it), kappa_i = |zbar_i|, theta_i = arg zbar_i, w_i = k_i/n. Under exact Benford with entity-level independence the country phases are iid uniform, so conditionally on the kappa_i:
          sigma_R = sqrt(0.5 * sum_i w_i^2 * kappa_i^2)
          P(|c1| > r) = exp(-r^2/(2*sigma_R^2))            (Rayleigh; Mardia & Jupp 2000 Rayleigh test)
          median = sigma_R*sqrt(2*ln 2) = 1.17741*sigma_R ; 2-sigma threshold r_2 = sqrt(2*sum w_i^2 kappa_i^2) = 2*sigma_R
          5% two-sided threshold = sigma_R*sqrt(-2 ln 0.05) = 2.44775*sigma_R ; 80%-power MDA (Rice, noncentrality nu = 3.0) = 3.0*sigma_R
        With kappa_i = 1 and equal weights: sigma_R = 1/sqrt(2*n_c) = 0.04603, r_2 = 0.09206, 5% = 0.11269, median = 0.05419, MDA = 0.13810.
    (d) OPERATIVE INSTRUMENT. Country-rotation randomization null (defined here, one definition, used with these exact words everywhere after): for country i draw phi_i ~ Uniform[0,1) independently and set every one of that country's mantissas m*_it = (m_it + phi_i) mod 1; recompute the whole five-statistic battery. Because E_phi[p*_d] = b_d EXACTLY for any data (b_d = log10(1+1/d)), this is an exact level-alpha test of 'country decade placements are independent and uniform'. B = 10,000; two-sided p = min(1, 2*min(#{T* >= T_obs}+1, #{T* <= T_obs}+1)/(B+1)). Pre-registered as operative.
        SECONDARY INSTRUMENT (reported, not operative): the parametric placebo of iteration 1 - one uniform mantissa per country then years wandering at the measured within-country sd - kept precisely so the plan can show WHY the two prior instruments disagreed.
    (e) VERDICT RULES. A statistic 'is consistent with exact Benford' iff rotation-null p >= 0.05 AND analytic p >= 0.01. Fold verdict 'consistent' iff all five are consistent. Fold stability: same verdict on even and odd. Disjoint-fold rule: estimate-stability - all four per-fold |c1| inside the 95% Rayleigh interval of the pooled estimate AND a homogeneity test (Cochran Q on the four |c1|) at p >= 0.05.
    (f) PRECOMMITTED OUTCOMES. Both branches written in advance: if observed |c1| > 2*sigma_R(corrected) the verdict is 'the panel exceeds its cluster envelope on the circular-mean statistic, by amplitude X against predicted mixture budget A'; if not, the verdict is 'inside'. Neither branch is preferred; the recorded values 0.0749/0.0752 sit near the crossing, so this is a real test.
    (g) INTEGRITY GATE + HASH. sha256 of panel md5 a338376ff319aa913078df4669fde237 and of every analysis/*.py at freeze time, recorded in the pre-registration. Post-run audit asserts the pre-registration hash precedes main.py's first panel read (mtimes + a run-log timestamp).

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- STAGE 1: PANEL + INTEGRITY
  load full_data_out.json from the dependency (stream with json.load; ~300 MB RSS transiently, fine on 16 GB).
  rows = [e for e in full if e['metadata_in_primary_analysis'] is True]
  ASSERT (known-answer tests; STOP and report, do not silently continue, if any fails):
    len(rows) == 17464 ; n_entities == 236 ; len(even) == 8732 ; len(odd) == 8732 ; every entity has exactly 74 years 1950..2023
    no duplicate (iso_code, year) and no duplicate (entity, year)
    sum(population for year == 2023) == 8090655899
    mantissa in [0,1) ; d1 == int(str-derived first significant digit) for all rows, with the one documented exact-decade boundary case whitelisted by (entity, year)
    full_data_out.json md5 == a338376ff319aa913078df4669fde237 (via hashlib, size-independent)
  If full_data_out.json is absent or the md5/2023-sum fails: rerun the dependency's data.py recipe (staged) to rebuild; if that is unavailable, download the OWID grapher CSV for 'population-with-un-projections' and World Bank WDI SP.POP.TOTL (API v2, indicator SP.POP.TOTL, date 1960:2023, per_page 20000), reapply the same aggregate-exclusion rule, and tag provenance = 'reacquired' in every output row. Never proceed on a panel that fails the 2023 sum by more than 0.01%.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- STAGE 2: THE FIVE STATISTICS (one implementation, used by every instrument)
  def digit_counts(mantissas) -> int[9] via bins [log10 d, log10(d+1))
  def stat_battery(mantissas) -> dict:
     MAD        = mean_d |counts_d/n - b_d|
     chisq      = sum_d (O_d - n*b_d)^2/(n*b_d), df = 8
     M_sup      = sup_m |F_emp(m) - m|            (KS distance to uniform on sorted mantissas)
     kuiper_V   = max(F_emp - m) + max(m - F_emp)
     c1         = weighted mean of exp(2*pi*i*m); return modulus and phase_deg = degrees(angle)
     also kappa_i per entity, theta_i, and w_i (needed by STAGE 3)

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- STAGE 3: RECONCILIATION (two-row table + algebra + calibration)
  ROW_DEFECTIVE:  rho = MSB/(MSB+MSW), DE_rho = 1+(k-1)*rho, n_eff_rho = n/DE_rho
  ROW_DECLARED:   ICC1 = (MSB-MSW)/(MSB+(k-1)*MSW), DE_ICC = 1+(k-1)*ICC1, n_eff_ICC = n/DE_ICC
  Columns: estimator name, point value, DE, n_eff, AND 'statistic class this n_eff governs' (MAD/chisq/M/Kuiper vs none-for-|c1|).
  ALGEBRA IDENTITY (assert on the fitted pair, exact to 1e-12): rho - ICC1 == ((k-1)*x + x^2)/((1+x)*(1+(k-1)*x)) >= 0 with x = MSW/MSB. Therefore the defective estimator can only OVER-state dependence and UNDER-state n_eff - the screen's bias has a sign, and the plan prints it.
  CONSISTENCY CHECK (this is the reconciliation's key diagnostic; assert and report):
     the two recorded thresholds are ONE formula at two n: r_2(n) = 2*sqrt(0.5*sum w^2 kappa^2 * (n_c/n)) evaluated at n = 246 -> 0.0901 and n = 976 -> 0.0453 when sum w^2 kappa^2 = 1/236.
     Print the table r_2 at n in {236, 246, 976} and mark 236 as the only value with a degrees-of-freedom meaning for c1.
  PAIR-IDENTIFIABILITY (report as a finding, not a failure): from rho = 1/(1+x) with rho = 0.9575 -> x = 0.044374 -> ICC1 = 0.36790; from ICC1 = 0.2206 with k = 37 -> x = 0.087166 -> rho = 0.91983. Since neither pair reproduces the other, the two recorded numbers CANNOT be the same variable under the same estimator pair; the plan requires a one-line statement of which variate each came from (candidate: 0.9575 on a per-country mean-of-years variate, 0.2206 on the row-level indicator/mantissa variate) and reports both rows rather than adjudicating a mis-match.
  KAPPA CALIBRATION (the diagnostic that explains the placebo/analytic disagreement):
     observed mean w_i^2 kappa_i^2 -> sigma_R_obs -> r_2,obs, 5%_obs, MDA_obs
     parametric placebo's implied kappa: simulate 1,000 placebo panels; record their mean w^2 kappa^2 -> r_2,placebo
     REPORT the ratio r_2,placebo / r_2,obs. If >> 1, the prior placebo was too wide because its wander model does not reproduce the observed within-country concentration (a country's mantissa drifts secularly across decades; i.i.d. wander around a fixed base does not) - and that, together with n_eff-vs-n_c, is the complete explanation of iteration 1's two contradictory verdicts. Then show the rotation null needs no such modelling: its kappa_i are the observed ones BY CONSTRUCTION.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- STAGE 4: DERIVATION VALIDATION ON SYNTHETIC PANELS
  Synthetic generator: 236 entities x 37 years, with controls for (i) base mantissa law, (ii) within-country wander sd s in {0.02, 0.05, 0.10, 0.20} decades, (iii) secular drift d in {0, 0.3, 0.6} decades over the window (linear in year, wrapped), (iv) serial structure {iid, AR1(0.8)}. Seeds 0..199 per cell.
  VALIDATION ASSERTIONS (each printed with the tolerance actually achieved):
    V1 rotation null is exact: for a synthetic panel drawn from exact-Benford-with-independence, the fraction of B=2,000 rotation replicates rejecting at alpha=0.05 is in [0.03, 0.07] for all five statistics, over 500 panels (FPR se 0.0097).
    V2 Rayleigh matches simulation for |c1|: over the same panels, the rotation-null sd of |c1| equals sigma_R from the observed kappa to within 2% relative, and the empirical 5% quantile of |c1| equals 2.44775*sigma_R to within 3%.
    V3 the n_eff-substituted threshold is mis-calibrated by the predicted factor: plugging n_eff (from STAGE 3) into r_2 = sqrt(2/n_eff) reproduces the recorded 0.0453 and 0.0901, and is smaller than the true r_2 by sqrt(n_c/n_eff) - print the factor (2.03 at n_eff = 976). This DISSOLVES the contradiction instead of adjudicating between two wrong numbers.
    V4 time-order insensitivity: for every statistic, the value on a panel whose rows are randomly permuted in time equals the unpermuted value exactly (all five are marginal statistics). This licenses using the iid-wander placebo as a sensitivity variant and rules out a reviewer objection that serial correlation was ignored.
    V5 power of the instruments at the observed scale: on synthetic panels with a planted first-harmonic amplitude A in {0.035, 0.075, 0.11, 0.14}, report rejection rates for |c1| under the rotation null. Assert monotone increase and that A = 0.11-0.14 is detected at >= 0.8 and A = 0.035 is detected at < 0.2. This is the pre-registered discrimination-power curve.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- STAGE 5: THE BATTERY, BOTH FOLDS, ALL INSTRUMENTS
  for fold in [even, odd]:
     for each of the five statistics T:
        T_obs on the fold's 8,732 mantissas
        instrument R (operative): rotation null, B = 10,000 -> two-sided p, median-null, observed/median ratio
        instrument A (analytic): p from the closed form (Rayleigh for |c1|; DE-scaled chi-square p = P(chi2_8 > X^2/DE); Stephens p for Kuiper with n_eff; Wilson/Bonferroni intervals for MAD at n and n_eff)

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- STAGE 6: ENTITY-DISJOINT FOLDS + STABILITY + POWER BOUND

  per-fold MDA (80% power) and the 5% detection threshold - printed so the reader sees each fold is a 59-country test
  homogeneity: Cochran Q on the four |c1| (each with its own sigma_R) -> p
  COUNTRY BOOTSTRAP: resample 236 countries with replacement 10,000 times, recompute the pooled |c1| -> percentile CI. (Note in the output that this is a resampling of the census and is a stability measure, not a sampling CI.)
  JACKKNIFE: delete-one-country influence on |c1|; report the 10 most influential countries by |delta| and the leave-one-out range.
  POWER BOUND (the pre-registered replacement for '88.7% overlap'):

fallback_plan: |-
  1. DEPENDENCY MISSING OR CORRUPT. If full_data_out.json is not staged or its md5 != a338376ff319aa913078df4669fde237 or the 2023 sum != 8,090,655,899: run the staged data.py recipe to rebuild; if that fails, download the OWID grapher CSV for 'population-with-un-projections' (use the estimates column through 2023, medium variant 2024-2025, both flagged is_projection) and World Bank WDI SP.POP.TOTL from the API (api.worldbank.org/v2/country/all/indicator/SP.POP.TOTL?format=json&per_page=20000&date=1960:2023), applying the same aggregate-exclusion rule. Tag provenance = 'reacquired' on every output row and re-derive the entity count (if 236 does not reproduce, use whatever count the rebuild yields and report it - never silently pad). Re-check n_c in every threshold, since the whole power argument is a function of n_c.
  2. ROTATION NULL DISAGREES WITH RAYLEIGH (>2% on sd or >3% on the 5% quantile). Demote Rayleigh to descriptive, make the rotation null the sole threshold (it is exact by construction and needs no distributional assumption), and REPORT the discrepancy as a finding. Do not average them or pick the smaller.
  3. OBSERVED |c1| EXCEEDS 2*sigma_R UNDER THE CORRECTED RECIPE. This is a precommitted branch, not a failure: take the 'exceeds' verdict sentence, report the calibrated magnitude (observed amplitude, corrected 2-sigma and 5% thresholds, the canonical mixture budget, and the ratio), and state which mechanism could produce a coherent between-country decade alignment. Do NOT revert to the design-effect threshold to get the friendlier answer - that is the estimator-shopping the reconciliation exists to prevent, and the post-run audit will show it.
  4. MEAN kappa^2 COMES OUT MUCH SMALLER THAN 1 (likely, because countries drift across decades). Then sigma_R shrinks, thresholds shrink, and the verdict may flip - report it. Also report the consequence for the discrimination bound: required n_c falls proportionally, so recompute the shortfall rather than reusing the kappa^2 = 1 numbers.
  5. EM DOES NOT CONVERGE OR BIC SELECTS ONE COMPONENT. Use 20 multistart seeds with deterministic quantile initialisation and a fixed tolerance; if BIC still prefers one component, take A_canon = exp(-2*pi^2*sigma^2) from the closed-form single lognormal, mark the mixture branch 'unavailable under BIC', and still deliver the canonicalization table (A_nocancel = A_canon in the single-component case, which itself resolves the 0.035767/0.035474 question by showing no cancellation exists).
  6. A STATISTIC IS UNDEFINED ON A SUBSET (e.g. an empty digit cell in a small disjoint fold). Return NaN with a reason string, never raise and never silently drop the cell from the Holm family.
  7. PROVENANCE LATTICE MATCHES NOTHING. Report 'not reproducible from the panel', give the reproducible replacement, and record that the prior values are superseded and unverifiable. Do not tune definitions until something matches - the lattice is fixed and pre-registered (74 snapshot years + 6 circular-mean variants) and nothing outside it may be tried.
  8. RUNTIME OVERRUN. Staged scaling per aii-long-running-tasks: mini gate (one fold, B=300, 20 synthetic panels) -> confirm all assertions behave -> scale to B=10,000 and 500 panels. Budget: full run ~40 min on 2 vCPUs. If past 90% of the 6h clock, ship B=4,000 and 200 panels and say so in the output; never ship an unvalidated derivation.
  9. NO WEB ACCESS AT EXECUTION TIME. Everything except two citation confirmations is offline. If the executor cannot confirm Lesperance et al. 2016 and McGraw & Wong 1996, cite them as '[VERIFY]' in the report's reference list rather than asserting page numbers, and drop the named-novelty paragraph's unconfirmed neighbours to what can be checked - the report must not contain an invented citation.
testing_plan: |-
  STAGE-GATED, cheapest first, each gate a hard go/no-go before the next.

  GATE 0 - KNOWN-ANSWER ARITHMETIC (seconds, no panel). Unit-test the closed forms against values verified by hand at planning time: b_d to 6 dp; the (65,33,35,23,17,17,21,10,15)/236 vector must give MAD 0.017287 and chi-square 9.449; rho = 0.9575 with k = 37 must give DE 35.47 and n_eff 246.2; ICC1 = 0.2206 with k = 37 must give DE 8.94 and n_eff 976.7; sigma_R at mean kappa^2 = 1, n_c = 236 must give 0.04603 and r_2 = 0.09206; r_2 at n = 246 and n = 976 must give 0.0901 and 0.0453. If any of these fails, the formulas are wrong - stop before touching the panel.

  GATE 1 - PANEL INTEGRITY (seconds). 17,464 primary rows, 236 entities, 74 years each, 8,732/8,732 fold split, no duplicate keys, 2023 sum 8,090,655,899, md5 match. Confirmation signal: the mantissa-vs-d1 agreement rate and the single whitelisted decade-boundary case.

  GATE 2 - EXACTNESS OF THE ROTATION NULL (minutes, synthetic). 20 panels, B = 200: FPR at alpha 0.05 within [0.02, 0.09] for each statistic, and E[p*_d] = b_d to 1e-3 across replicates. Confirmation signal: the rotation-null median of MAD is near the conventional i.i.d. median times an inflation, and the rotation-null median of |c1| equals 1.1774*sigma_R.

  GATE 3 - RAYLEIGH vs SIMULATION (minutes). V2 tolerance met (2% on sd, 3% on the 5% quantile) before any verdict is computed. If not met, switch to the fallback (rotation null only) before proceeding, not after.

  GATE 4 - TIME-ORDER INSENSITIVITY (seconds). Permute the panel's row order and assert all five statistics are bit-identical. This is the earliest signal that the marginal-statistic claim is right, and it retro-licenses the iid-wander placebo as a sensitivity variant.

  GATE 5 - POWER SUITE BEHAVES (minutes). Uniform-digit law (log10(1+9u)) rejected at p<0.0005 for MAD and chi-square; narrow lognormal sigma = 0.1 rejected; an i.i.d. uniform-mantissa panel flagged over-regular (MAD pulled below the observed). Confirmation signal: the instruments can reject at all - without this, a 'consistent' verdict means nothing.

  GATE 6 - VERDICT-NUMBER REPLICATION (for orientation only, NOT an assertion of correctness). Print what this run's code gives for the pooled even-fold MAD, chi-square, sup-M, Kuiper V, |c1| and phase next to the recorded 0.00919, 83.2, 0.03065, 0.0561, 0.0749/-1.5733 rad. Replication is reassuring but NOT decisive: the recorded values came from a different row-selection and a possibly different entity set, so a small offset is expected and must be reported, not tuned away. A LARGE offset (>5%) means the row selection differs - diagnose before writing any verdict.

  GATE 7 - SCALE UP. Only after Gates 0-6: B = 10,000 rotation replicates, 500-panel calibration, 4 disjoint folds, 10,000 bootstrap resamples, 20 EM starts. Log wall-clock per gate and extrapolate (aii-long-running-tasks); confirm peak RSS under 4 GB (aii-use-hardware) before the bootstrap stage, since bootstrap allocation is the one place a naive implementation can blow memory.

  GATE 8 - INDEPENDENT RE-DERIVATION. verify.py matches to 1e-12 on every headline quantity and the fresh-seed rotation p agrees within Monte-Carlo error. Any mismatch is a bug in one path; find it, do not relax the tolerance.

  GATE 9 - SCHEMA AND PACKAGING. aii-json validates the output against exp_gen_sol_out on full/mini/preview; aii-file-size-limit check on every written file; a self-test that the pre-registration hash and mtime precede the run log's first panel read (the audit the reviewer will ask for).

  REVIEWER-FACING SELF-CHECK before declaring done: (i) the two-row table has a column literally naming which statistic class each n_eff governs; (ii) both verdict branches are written in the report, with the taken one marked and the untaken one's numbers still shown; (iii) the power/discrimination bound is present with the required-n_countries figure; (iv) every ablation and disjoint-fold pass count is reported honestly as a count out of its denominator, alongside its detection threshold, so nobody can read a 2/4 as evidence; (v) the named-novelty paragraph exists and names a real delta; (vi) no number in the report is inherited without being either recomputed here or explicitly labelled 'recorded, not recomputed'.
